text: The echo state property requires that a reservoir driven by a bounded input sequence forgets its initial condition, so its state asymptotically depends only on the input history.
explanation: This is exactly Definition 2.1: for every input sequence and every pair of initial states, ||X_t(u,x) - X_t(u,x')|| -> 0. State-forgetting makes the reservoir a well-defined nonlinear functional (the echo function) of the input history alone, which is the whole point of the ESP.
